title: Responsible cosmetic dentistry
description: Veneers, whitening, and refined esthetic changes — only when the tooth is healthy enough and the result is realistic, not exaggerated.

items.name: In-office whitening
items.description: Professional whitening with controlled concentration. Best for patients with healthy teeth who want a moderate shade change.

items.name: Direct composite veneers
items.description: Chair-side veneers in composite, minimally invasive and reversible. Good for shape corrections and small chips.

items.name: Porcelain veneers
items.description: Lab-fabricated veneers for the most natural and durable esthetic result. Requires healthy underlying teeth and gums.

items.name: Esthetic consultation
items.description: Discussion of what you'd like to change, with an honest assessment of what's realistic and what isn't.

process: Discussion of what you'd like to change
Exam and health check (no esthetics on unhealthy teeth)
Digital preview or wax-up when possible
Treatment in one or more visits

faqs.a: Porcelain veneers require irreversible tooth preparation. Composite veneers can be removed. I'll explain the trade-offs so you choose with full information.
No. I work with conservative shape and shade choices. The goal is to make your teeth look like the best version of themselves, not like they belong to someone else.

faqs.q: Can I whiten my teeth at home?
faqs.a: I can make you custom trays and provide professional gel for home use. It's slower than in-office but gives more control over the final shade.

faqs.q: What if my teeth aren't suitable?
faqs.a: If I think a treatment won't give you a result you'd be happy with, I tell you before starting. Sometimes the best cosmetic result requires fixing the foundation first.
